about: Published values that research found attached to an organisation but that are not its route: another organisation's inbox or phone, a fax, or an inbox on a domain that does not exist. Each entry is reviewed and sourced. scripts/contacts/build_contact_profiles.py leaves the value out of that organisation's profile, so the welfare and government runs never take it and the company-master merge never adds it. A value already in the company master is corrected through skills/silverleaf-update-lead-list: for a 'master' entry, scripts/contacts/merge_master_contacts.py --apply takes the value out of the organisation's email or phone, its contacts and its drafts' channel (the draft falls back to the organisation's other route, else is held for a route), keeps it as the fact 'rejected_route' with the reason, and adds a review item. Match is by database and organisation (the name resolves a changed organisation ID) and by the value, normalised.
